run_handler: run the handler function to load and split the Flickr Materials Database from a zip file
write_fixture: write a test fixture zip with placeholder RGB images for each material class
path_to_label: extract a material class label index from a file path using the CLASS_NAMES list
summarize_dataset: summarize the flickr_material_database_dataset DownloadableDataset configuration including download URLs and metadata
review_CLASS_NAMES: review the CLASS_NAMES list of ten material categories including fabric foliage glass leather metal paper plastic stone water and wood
